A [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] was the '''grub mother''' of [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Vicelord]] [[Siv Kav]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

==Behind the scenes==
The grub mother was mentioned in the [[2006]] novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" />
